title: Seamless Christmas Digital Paper
author: FuN ArT
description:
🎄✨ Bring festive magic to your creative projects with the Seamless Christmas Digital Paper Pack! This collection includes 20 beautifully designed digital papers featuring timeless holiday patterns such as snowflakes, candy canes, holly leaves, ornaments, stripes, stars, and cozy winter textures. Each design is created to be seamless, making them perfect for continuous backgrounds and large-scale projects.
All papers come in high-resolution 300 DPI, sized at 3600 x 3600 pixels (12” x 12”), ensuring crisp, professional-quality results for both digital and print use. Delivered in one easy-to-download ZIP file, these patterns are ready to add seasonal charm to your designs.
✨ Product Details:
20 Seamless Christmas Digital Papers 🎁❄️
File Size: 3600 x 3600 pixels (12” x 12”)
High-Resolution 300 DPI
Delivered in 1 ZIP File
🎅 Perfect For:
✔ Scrapbooking & card making
✔ Gift wrapping & packaging design
✔ DIY holiday crafts & party décor
✔ Invitations, tags & labels
✔ Digital planners & printable backgrounds
Make your holiday creations shine with this Seamless Christmas Digital Paper Pack—a must-have collection for crafters, designers, and Christmas lovers! 🎄✨
